newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ registered unemployed up slightly in August.
newsitem.headline: NZ registered unemployed up slightly in August.

text.p: The number of New Zealanders registered as unemployed rose 1,036 in August to 154,328, Employment Minister Wyatt Creech said on Thursday.
He attributed the rise to changes in benefit abatement rates which had led to new groups of people looking for work.
"With more opportunities visible, more job seekers are moving into the labour market," Creech said.
He said uncertainty about the October 12 general election was also affecting some employment decisions.
The proportion of long-term unemployed (for 26 weeks or longer) on the register stood at 62,597, a drop to 40.6 percent of the register from 44.4 percent in August 1995.
The official measure of unemployment is the Household Labour Force Survey, which showed the jobless rate at 6.1 percent in the June quarter.
